quizzes.backend_description: This image shows a circular protractor with a green shaded angle. One ray points directly to the right at 0°, and the other ray extends upward and to the right, stopping at the 35° mark. The angle is shaded in light green, and the arc is highlighted in dark green. The angle being shown measures 35 degrees.
solution: The part of the circle inside the angle tells you the angle's measure.
The angle ends on dash number 7. The dashes are 5° apart, so count by 5° 7 times.
The measure of the angle is 35°.
